name: flask-2a8a38b0-blind20-v1-ots
instr:
# Flask: misbehaving JSON, blueprints, views and CLI — diagnose and repair without a test suite

The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. The effects show up all over the framework, so here is what I have actually observed, grouped by area.

## Flashed messages

Flashing a message still marks the session as modified as it always did, but reading the messages back inside a request no longer works at all — the read blows up instead of returning the list. It fails the same way whether I ask for the categories along with the messages, ask for the messages alone, or pass a category filter.

## JSON responses and serialization

A response built from the JSON helper still has the right status code and the right content type, but the bytes of the body are not what they used to be: the payload comes out spread over multiple lines with indentation instead of the compact single-line form, so any comparison against the exact body fails. Plain responses that carry no JSON are unaffected.

Asking the module-level helper to write an object as JSON into an already-open text file does not work — the call errors out, and nothing readable ends up in the file. Reading JSON back from a file object is fine.

Serializing an object that exposes an HTML representation of itself now raises an error rather than producing that HTML as a JSON string.

## The tagged serializer (the one used for signed session-style data)

Dumping a value and loading it straight back very often no longer
